name: Speech synthesis voices
plain: Installed text-to-speech voices, which reveal OS, version and installed language packs.
meaning: macOS lists 100+ voices, Windows 10 to 30, Android per Google TTS pack. Exact list shows OS version and which languages the person installed, a strong stable fingerprint.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: name
fields.range: e.g. Samantha, Microsoft David, Google US English

limits.headline: Can list the speech voices on your device, which hint at your OS and languages
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads or speaks text
can: List installed voices, from about 10 on Windows to 100 or more on macOS
Guess your OS version and language packs from the list
Offer a speak text feature in a voice you pick
Use the list as a steady tracking clue
cannot: Listen to you or record sound
See your speech or text you wrote
Know which voice you like best
Get the same list on every browser or device

story.what_it_is: The list of text to speech voices installed on your device, which reveals system and languages.

marketing.name: Web Speech API
marketing.pitch: Docs describe how pages can speak text aloud using voices on the device.

story.for_you: You never see the check. If a site reads text aloud, it can use a voice you have installed. The same list can show which languages you added and what system you run.
story.for_makers: Reading aloud helps accessibility and language learning. The voice list changes by system, version and language pack, so it is also a strong fingerprint. Trackers read it for that reason.

use_cases.example: A news site offers a Listen button that reads the story aloud in the voice you have installed.
A language learning site picks a native speaker style voice for your language to read sentences aloud.
A browser story game reads dialogue out loud with the best voice available on the device.
A children's reading site speaks each word aloud so early readers can follow.
A web editor reads your draft back so you can hear mistakes.
A fingerprint vendor reads the voice list as a stable ID piece.
A traffic tool estimates language packs installed to judge international audiences.

history.change: Voice list restricted for known fingerprinting scripts (Advanced Fingerprinting Protection)
